immutability_rule.statement: After this Execution Freeze, none of the following may change under this freeze identity.
must_not_change: bridge bytes — BRIDGE-CANDIDATE.yaml and every element it declares
the Design Freeze, which remains immutable under its own freeze identity
immutability_rule.why: The bridge was frozen before the blind case became visible. That ordering is the entire evidential content of a blind case: if the bridge can still move once B-01 is readable, the case stops testing anything.
any_necessary_change_requires: an explicitly identified successor Execution Freeze
this freeze preserved intact, not overwritten
a non-retroactive treatment of anything already recorded under this identity
immutability_rule.prohibited: No silent repair under the same experiment or freeze identity. Editing a frozen item without a successor does not produce a corrected experiment; it produces a record nobody can rely on.

immutability_rule.verification: Every frozen item above carries a digest, so later divergence is caught by re-measurement rather than by memory.
